Some of my key limitations include:

**Knowledge & Information:**
- My training data has a cutoff date, so I lack information about very recent events
- I can't browse the internet or access real-time information
- I may have gaps or inaccuracies in my knowledge base

**Capabilities:**
- I can't learn or remember information between separate conversations
- I can't perform actions in the real world or interact with external systems
- I can't process images, audio, or video (text only)
- I can't run code or perform real-time calculations beyond what I can do step-by-step

**Reasoning:**
- I can make mistakes in logic, math, or analysis
- I may struggle with tasks requiring very long chains of reasoning
- I can be inconsistent across different phrasings of similar questions

**Uncertainty:**
- I don't always know the boundaries of my own knowledge
- I may sound confident even when uncertain
- I can't always distinguish between what I know vs. what seems plausible

**Personal limitations:**
- I don't have subjective experiences, emotions, or consciousness in the way humans do
- I can't form lasting relationships or memories of our interactions

Is there a particular area where you're wondering about my limitations? I'm happy to be more specific about what I can and can't help with.
